verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Gitleaks CLI runs fully offline/local with no server component (gitleaks-probe-5), which implies no server-side data retention, but there is no explicit documentation of a data retention/deletion policy or user-facing controls for it, and gitleaks-action (which posts PR comments and uses tokens) has no stated retention/deletion mechanism either. Missing for 10: any documented retention policy, deletion controls, or data lifecycle statement for gitleaks-action or the CLI's report/baseline files.
